beats.text: Nobody lives 969 years. So what happened?
beats.scene: Painted ancient patriarch with white beard at sunrise, camera drifting. Overlay: counter 969.

beats.text: The oldest verified person, Jeanne Calment, died at one hundred twenty-two.
beats.scene: Elderly woman's hands holding a cane in warm light. Overlay: counter 122.

beats.text: Methuselah's age is almost eight times that.
beats.scene: Two tall bars growing side by side. Overlay: ratio badge 8x.

beats.text: Now take your own age. Multiply it by eight.
beats.scene: Close-up of a hand with a wristwatch. Overlay: counter x8.

beats.text: Mesopotamia has the Sumerian King List.
beats.scene: Cuneiform tablet in lamplight. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Its kings before the flood reign tens of thousands of years.
beats.scene: Row of ancient kings on thrones, fading into mist. Overlay: counter tens of thousands.

beats.text: So the Bible's numbers look modest in comparison.
beats.scene: Papyrus with short columns of numbers. Overlay: compare bars.

beats.text: Methuselah is the longest-lived person in the Bible.
beats.scene: Aged patriarch seated by a tent fire at night. Overlay: counter 969.

beats.text: One theory: the numbers are symbolic, not literal.
beats.scene: Scribe etching sacred numerals on clay. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Another: ancient scribes used base sixty, and the scaling changed.
beats.scene: Clay tablet with wedge numerals. Overlay: counter base 60.

beats.text: By the genealogy, he dies in the very year of the flood.
beats.scene: Dark storm clouds over a patriarch's tent at dusk. Overlay: sum 187+182+600 = 969.

beats.text: Not proven: nobody knows how to read these ages.
beats.scene: Open book with blank pages. Overlay: question mark badge.
Patriarch silhouette under a vast sky, slow push. Overlay: choice tags A literal / B symbolic.

youtube.title: Did Methuselah Really Live 969 Years? #shorts
youtube.description:
Genesis 5:27 says Methuselah lived 969 years. Where did that number come from?
Scholars debate how to read it; none of the theories is proven.
#Methuselah #Genesis #Bible #BibleHistory
